# Aski

> Swift package converting images to ASCII art via 60D log-polar shape matching and OKLab color processing. Targets iOS 18+, macOS 15+, visionOS 2+. Strict Swift 6 concurrency. Pre-1.0; the API is usable for experimentation but may change before 1.0.0.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/README.md): Installation, the conversion API, and rendering options.
- [Design notes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/DESIGN.md): Algorithm overview and descriptor lineage.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BigCactusLabs/Aski/main/AGENTS.md): Project conventions, hard rules, and pointers for AI coding agents working in this repo.

## API reference

- DocC catalog source: `Sources/Aski/Aski.docc/` (API reference source).
